name: Pogo Simulator
desc:
🦘Welcome to Pogo Simulator,
Bounce around on your pogo stick to collect coins to increase your jump power and unlock new pogo sticks! Try and collect all the pogo sticks and max out the rebirths. 

What is available in the game ?
🦘Bounce around to earn Coins!
🚀Jump higher by upgrading your power!
🌍Unlock new Pogo sticks!
🔮Rebirth!
📨Jump to new areas!

🌝Don't forget to Like and Favorite!
🦘Thanks For Playing Pogo Simulator!
